items.title: A characterisation of bounded projective amplitude for a complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises complexes of bounded projective amplitude through the existence of a resolution by a bounded complex of finite projective modules, and the proof is a 53-line argument that first reduces to a bounded representative of the complex and then constructs the resolution degree by degree. At each degree it chooses a finitely generated projective module mapping onto the cohomology in that degree and lifts the differential, and it uses the boundedness of the amplitude to show that the construction terminates. The construction and the termination argument are the two parts of the proof and both are displayed.
